Large plane trees form a continuous canopy over the promenade. On the right, closely packed mid-century and older facades face the cobblestones; repeated German no-stopping signs are posted along the curb. This matches several short riverside lanes in Cologne’s Altstadt-Nord near the Rhine promenade. Exact street identification is uncertain, but it appears to be a minor riverside access street just off the Rhine embankment in central Cologne.
